caption: 沧州铁狮原物
依2020年实拍保留残损与保护支架
source_note: 不使用狮城公园2011放大复制品；真实残缺、背负莲盆和必要支撑状态按实照。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes.  SUBJECT: The ORIGINAL Cangzhou Iron Lion cast in 953, as it survives in this verified 2020 photograph, viewed from the same near-side/front angle, head to the RIGHT. This is a conservation illustration of the damaged original, NOT a reconstruction and NOT the 2011 replica. Preserve the massive standing lion's open hollow damaged muzzle, broken missing nose area, incomplete eroded head and ears, curly mane, worn harness saddle panels, broad lotus bowl on its back, original heavy legs and all currently absent fragments. Do not invent teeth, a complete muzzle, tail or missing toes. Preserve the necessary external steel pipe and diagonal support cradle around the feet/body as thin secondary contours, matching its actual layout; this is essential conservation support and must not be removed. Remove only distant modern buildings, fence, lamps and trees. Landscape 1536x1024, complete bowl, head, steel support frame and low stone plinth all visible with generous margins. Keep silhouette accurate and distinctive; use sparse contour hints for casting joints and weathering, NO dense cracks/grain/hatching; all sculpture surfaces, hollow mouth and steel pipes remain white inside black outlines. Black and white fine line art.

site_recommendation.name: 沧州铁狮子
site_recommendation.sub: 旧州现存铁狮原物（保留残缺）
site_recommendation.yearNote: 不使用狮城公园2011放大复制品；真实残缺、背负莲盆和必要支撑状态按实照。
site_recommendation.lede: 千年铁铸巨狮背负莲盆，残损躯体与支撑钢架并存，记录后周冶铸工艺和漫长的保护历程。

facts.label: 纪年
facts.text: 铁狮身有“大周广顺三年铸”铭文，对应953年，为后周大型铁铸遗存。

facts.label: 造型
facts.text: 巨狮昂首张口、身披鞍饰，背负莲盆；现物头部、腿足等处存在明显断损。

facts.label: 现状
facts.text: 图版依据2020年原物照片保留残损及钢管支撑，不采用2011年新铸复制品，也不补造缺失部位。

quality_check.notes: 已核实原物与生成，背负莲盆、空缺口鼻和外支撑完整，非复制品；必要支架保留。
